question: How is the Shiva-point related to the letter ma in scriptural teaching?
premises: In scripture this is spoken of as the point.
That point is regarded as the Shiva-point.
It is other than the letter ma and bears only its reflection.
inference: The Shiva-point is distinct from the phoneme ma, though ma reflects it.
plain_english: In the scriptures this is described as the point and is regarded as the Shiva-point. It is different from the letter ma, bearing only a reflection of it.
